description: This file defines the 'Menu' controller class in the OpenCart system, responsible for generating the category menu displayed on the storefront. It loads categories and subcategories, prepares data for the view, and returns the rendered menu HTML.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating and returning the category menu view.
